`-d + (0.3 + 0.3 * p + 0.15 * (1 - c)) * r + (0.15 - 0.1 * p + 0.1 * (1 - c)) * g`

Where:
- d = distance (current-to-candidate)
- r = return_distance (candidate-to-start)
- g = regret (second-nearest minus nearest among other unvisited nodes)
- p = progress (visited fraction)
- c = cluster_density (fraction of other unvisited cities within mean distance)

def priority(f):
